text: Single web app: public shop + authenticated admin/evaluator area
description: One codebase/deployment at art.commons-hub.at (Cloudflare, Commons Hub account, wrangler env "commons"). Proposed: Vue (Vite) frontend + Worker API (Hono, Express-like) + D1 (SQLite) for paintings/ratings + R2 for images. Avoids using the single Supabase free DB.

status.comment: Scaffolded: Vue + Hono Worker + D1 (paintings, ratings) + R2, basic-auth admin from ADMINS secret. Runs locally. Not yet deployed: needs D1/R2 created in the Commons Hub account.
